decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Let me analyze this situation.

My active: Sylveon at 100%, with -1 SPA and -1 ATK, leftovers.

Opponent's active: Gholdengo at 79%, Good as Gold (immune to status moves), Steel/Ghost.

Sylveon's options:
- Hyper Voice: Normal becomes Fairy via Pixilate. But Gholdengo is Steel/Ghost — Fairy is not very effective vs Steel (0.5x), and Ghost is immune to... wait, Ghost is immune to Normal and Fighting. Fairy hits Ghost neutrally. Steel resists Fairy. So Hyper Voice (Pixilate Fairy) vs Steel/Ghost = 0.5x. Also Gholdengo... actually it says "no effect on gholdengo" in legal actions — wait, that's odd. It says "Normal, Special, power 90, 100% accuracy, no effect on gholdengo" — hmm, actually Ghost is immune to Normal-type moves. Pixilate converts it to Fairy though. But the game note says "no effect" — maybe the simulator treats it pre-conversion? Actually in real Pokémon, Pixilate changes the move to Fairy before damage calc, so it would hit Gholdengo at 0.5x. But turn 2 log shows "Your Sylveon used Hyper Voice - It was not very effective" against opposing Gholdengo, so Pixilate did apply and it's resisted. The legal action note might just be a mislabel. Anyway, Hyper Voice does resisted damage.

- Yawn: Status move — Good as Gold makes Gholdengo immune to status moves. So Yawn fails.

- Wish: status, fine.
- Protect: fine.

Opponent's Gholdengo has no revealed moves but standard Gholdengo runs Make It Rain / Shadow Ball / etc. It outspeeds Sylveon (80 vs 93-149). It could hit Sylveon with Make It Rain (Steel, neutral vs Fairy... Steel is not very effective vs Fairy actually — Steel is resisted by Fairy? No wait: Steel is super effective vs Fairy! Steel hits Fairy super effectively. Wait, no: Steel is SE against Ice, Rock, Fairy. Yes, Make It Rain would be super effective vs Sylveon. Sylveon's SpD is high (152), but Gholdengo SPA could be 137-203. Make It Rain 120 BP SE could do big damage.

Sylveon is at 100% though. Sylveon could Wish for recovery and pivot support, but Sylveon can't touch Gholdengo meaningfully.

My team: Kingambit (100%), Gholdengo fainted. Opponent still has one more to come from kingambit, palafin, garchomp, annihilape. Opponent revealed: Incineroar (73%), Gholdengo (79%), plus one more unseen.

My Kingambit: Dark/Steel with Supreme Overlord (but no allies fainted yet? Wait, my Gholdengo fainted! So Supreme Overlord gets +10% per fainted ally — 1 ally fainted, so +10%... actually Supreme Overlord gives +10% per fainted ally including... it counts fainted allies, base power boost. With Gholdengo fainted, Kingambit gets 1 boost = 110%).

Kingambit vs Gholdengo: Iron Head is SE vs Steel... Steel vs Steel is resisted. Dark vs Ghost... Kowtow Cleave Dark vs Ghost is SE (Dark hits Ghost SE), vs Steel resisted — net neutral? Dark vs Steel = 0.5x, Dark vs Ghost = 2x, so net 1x. Iron Head: Steel vs Steel = 0.5, vs Ghost = 1, net 0.5x. Sucker Punch: priority Dark, 1x net vs Gholdengo (needs target to attack).

Best play: Switch Sylveon out for Kingambit? Kingambit threatens Gholdengo with Kowtow Cleave (neutral 1x, but 205 ATK with Supreme Overlord boost) — that's decent damage. Gholdengo might Make It Rain vs Kingambit — Steel vs Dark SE? Steel vs Dark is SE, vs Steel resisted — net 1x? Wait Kingambit is Dark/Steel: Make It Rain vs Dark = 2x, vs Steel = 0.5x → net 1x. Neutral. Kingambit has huge SpD? No, SpD 107. It'd take moderate damage.

Alternatively stay in with Sylveon and Wish — Wish support for later. But Gholdengo threatens to Make It Rain Sylveon hard (SE). Sylveon 202 HP, SpD 152. Gholdengo SpA up to 203... 120 BP SE Make It Rain from a 185-ish SpA Gholdengo vs Sylveon: could be significant, maybe 60-80%? Sylveon's SpD is huge though. Let me estimate: Level 50, Gholdengo SpA ~185 (my own Gholdengo had 185), Make It Rain 120 BP, SE 2x. Sylveon: HP 202, SpD 152. Damage = ((2*50/5+2)*120*185/152)/50+2 = ((22)*120*1.217)/50+2 = (3212)/50+2 ≈ 64+2 = 66, ×2 (SE) ×1.5 (Life Orb?) = ~198. That could OHKO Sylveon! But opponent Gholdengo item unknown — mine had Life Orb; theirs likely similar. Even without Life Orb ~132-198 range. Actually variance 85-100%. Hmm, risky. That's a bad matchup.

So switching to Kingambit is the play. Kingambit resists nothing from Gholdengo but takes neutral Make It Rain (Dark/Steel makes it 1x) and Shadow Ball (Ghost vs Dark... Ghost is SE vs Ghost? No: Ghost hits Ghost SE. Ghost vs Dark = SE? Ghost is not very effective against Dark! Ghost attacks: SE vs Ghost, Psychic; resisted by Dark; Dark is immune... wait Ghost vs Dark = 0.5x (Dark resists Ghost). So Shadow Ball vs Dark/Steel = 0.5x net.

Kingambit counters Gholdengo well: takes neutral/ resisted hits, Kowtow Cleave hits back neutrally with massive attack, or Sucker Punch priority.

Also, opponent's Incineroar is at 73% in back. Kingambit vs Incineroar: Flare Blitz SE vs Kingambit, but Kingambit could Sucker Punch (Incineroar at 73%, likely dies to Sucker Punch from 205 ATK... Sucker Punch 70 BP, Dark vs Fire/Dark = Dark resists Dark 0.5x... Incineroar is Fire/Dark, so Sucker Punch resisted 0.5x. Kowtow Cleave also resisted). Hmm, Kingambit isn't great vs Incineroar. But right now facing Gholdengo, Kingambit is the better switch.

Decision: SWITCH: kingambit.

Wait — but consider Wish first? Sylveon at 100%, Wish is for healing later, but Sylveon might just die to Make It Rain. Switching preserves Sylveon and brings in a good matchup vs Gholdengo. Also there's a chance opponent switches Incineroar in expecting Kingambit? Whatever — switching to Kingambit is clearly best vs Gholdengo.

One concern: Intimidate already hit Sylveon; switching doesn't re-trigger. Kingambit incoming doesn't face Intimidate again unless Incineroar comes in later.

So: SWITCH: kingambit.
